hoy.titular: The Clausura ends today, and the Libertadores final is 21 days away
hoy.resumen: At 3 pm Pincha visit Talleres on the final matchday, already out of the play-off race. All eyes are on what comes next: the Supercopa Argentina on Thursday and the final against Palmeiras in Montevideo.
puntos: Libertadores final: Saturday 28/11, 5 pm, Estadio Centenario.
Supercopa Argentina v Independiente Rivadavia: Thursday 12/11, 8 pm, in Córdoba.
Coming off a 3-3 draw with Instituto at the UNO.

noticias.bajada: It will be played at the Centenario in Montevideo. Pincha are going for a fifth Libertadores.
